archiveTitle: Daily Brief | CONTROL Resonant Hands-On Explores Paranatural Manhattan

entries.headline: CONTROL Resonant Hands-On Highlights Paranatural Manhattan and Melee Builds
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog’s full-game hands-on details the sequel’s move from the Oldest House to a warped Manhattan. Dylan’s melee-leaning paranatural combat combines six primary and secondary Aberrants with multiple skill trees and swappable loadouts, while selected dialogue and memory-based side quests shape his characterization. The game is due September 24.
entries.verification: Based on the opened first-party PlayStation Blog hands-on; only its stated gameplay, PS5 context, and September 24 date are used.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from the PlayStation Blog page timestamp.

entries.headline: SophieChat:AI Announced as a Chat-Driven RPG Set in Atelier Sophie 2
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo Games and SpiralAI announced SophieChat:AI at Tokyo Game Show 2026 and opened pre-registration. The chat-driven RPG uses the world of Atelier Sophie 2 for adventure, alchemy, and battles, with artwork supervised by NOCO and voice material newly recorded by Yuka Aisaka. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: Cross-checked against opened reports from AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer, which agree on the announcement, pre-registration, NOCO supervision, and Yuka Aisaka voice material.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from the earlier report timestamp.

entries.headline: Get Us Out Announced as a Four-Player Co-op Prison Break
entries.summary: PlayWay announced Get Us Out, a prison-break action adventure developed by AM Playhouse. Up to four players plan an escape, find keys and tools, disable security, and rescue captured teammates. It is planned for PC via Steam, with no release date announced.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON report and limited to its stated publisher, developer, gameplay, and PC platform details.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from the AUTOMATON page timestamp.

entries.headline: BrainWash: Zombie Cleanup Announced as a Co-op Post-Outbreak Cleanup Sim
entries.summary: Solo developer Haz Games announced BrainWash: Zombie Cleanup. Set near the end of a 1950s zombie outbreak, players working for Raincoat Industries first eliminate remaining zombies and then clean up the blood and bodies left behind. The game supports co-op and is planned for PC via Steam, with no release date announced.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON report and limited to its stated announcement, developer, mechanics, and PC platform.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from the AUTOMATON page timestamp.

entries.headline: パールインブルー TGS Presentation Details Its Monthly Romantic-Comedy Direction
entries.summary: Netmarble’s Tokyo Game Show 2026 presentation positioned パールインブルー as a romance-focused RPG for Japan. Its monthly romantic-comedy concept runs alongside a main story about desire; the stage also revealed a new promotional video, an anime-style opening, and the theme song 未完成のナイト performed by four Knights.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON event report and limited to details disclosed during the presentation.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from the AUTOMATON page timestamp.

entries.headline: KAELIS: Seraph Protocol Announced for PC, Planned for 2028
entries.summary: Seoul-based YoshiYoshi Studio announced KAELIS: Seraph Protocol, a single-player science-fantasy RPG. Players control Serenos Academy Executor Kaito through academy life, exploration, and turn-based investigations of Noise incidents, with choices affecting relationships and some cases. The PC release is planned for 2028 alongside a Kickstarter campaign seeking $27,000.
entries.verification: Based on the opened Gematsu report, which relays the announcement, official overview, Steam listing, and Kickstarter target.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from the Gematsu page timestamp.

entries.headline: Hela: Of Mice & Magic launches December 1 and joins Game Pass day one
entries.summary: The game will launch December 1, 2026 and enter Xbox Game Pass on day one. Its developers also detailed the Brewing & Remedies progression system.

entries.headline: CD Projekt Red engine strategy: CDPR co-CEO says the move to Unreal Engine 5 was not driven by Cyberpunk 2077's launch
entries.summary: Michał Nowakowski said CD Projekt Red's move away from REDengine was not a direct reaction to Cyberpunk 2077's launch issues, framing it as a longer-term technology strategy focused on making games rather than platform technology.
entries.verification: The opened VGC report relays Nowakowski's interview comments and their context.

entries.summary: 4Gamer’s TGS hands-on examines the updated Fox and Frog adventure. It opens in a lived-in apartment and follows a fox girl and her frog companion seeking a way home from a dark island. This is new hands-on analysis.

entries.headline: Control Resonant review weighs its open-world action and character story
entries.summary: IGN’s new review examines Control Resonant’s shift from the first game’s shooting and exploration toward open-world action and a more direct character story. The writer praises its bold conceptual continuity while finding some combat stretches frustrating or dull. These remain the reviewer’s opinions, with no aggregate score inferred.

entries.headline: BARKOUR hands-on discusses military-dog motion capture and agent movement
entries.summary: AUTOMATON’s newly published hands-on examines stealth, parkour and canine movement in VARSAV Game Studios’ BARKOUR. The developers describe motion capture using a former Polish special-forces dog and incorporating pets’ curiosity and distraction. The Steam demo is available; this does not establish that it has just launched.

entries.headline: ゆるキャン△: Yuru Camp game plans October 22 relaxation-app redesign and Steam version
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that enish announced on September 18 that the existing Yuru Camp game will end its old service on October 21 and become a Chill Time relaxation and work-support app the next day. Existing equipment, costumes and food carry over. A paid Steam Early Access version is planned for the same day.

entries.headline: Control Resonant PC analysis praises tested systems but notes Steam Deck strain
entries.summary: IGN’s independent PC analysis praises Control Resonant’s performance on most systems the writer tested and examines lighting and scaling to lower-end hardware. The writer also notes Steam Deck struggles at the chosen settings. These findings concern the author’s tests and are not guarantees for all hardware.
